subject.title: Add SQLite snapshot artifacts under backup

question: Should OpenClaw core ship `openclaw backup sqlite snapshot` as the Phase 1 local SQLite sync artifact contract after the branch cleanup?
rationale: This adds a new core operator CLI, serialized artifact format, and sensitive-state copy path; automation can flag defects but cannot decide whether this belongs in core before the pilot and stress follow-up complete.

options.title: Clean And Continue Core MVP
options.body: Remove unrelated lockfile drift and stale root-command policy, then review the cleaned Phase 1 core snapshot surface for maintainer acceptance.

options.title: Gate On Stress Pilot
options.body: Wait for the stress harness and Scout/Lobster pilot evidence before accepting the core artifact contract.

options.title: Pause Core Surface
options.body: Keep the draft paused or close it if maintainers decide this should stay host/plugin-owned for now.

recommendation.title: Clean And Continue Core MVP
recommendation.body: Remove unrelated lockfile drift and stale root-command policy, then review the cleaned Phase 1 core snapshot surface for maintainer acceptance.

likelyOwner.reason: Galin is assigned and already reviewed the snapshot artifact contract in this PR.
